sentences.text:
"Heard Shri Adarsh Kumar Maurya, learned counsel and Shri Shubham Yadav,
learned counsel for the applicant and Shri S. P. Tiwari, learned AGA for the State.
Shri Adarsh Kumar Maurya, learned counsel and Shri Shubham Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant contend that the applicant and the victim were intimate.
The F.I.R. is the result of the opposition of the victim's family to the said relationship.
The age of the victim as depicted in the medical certificate dated 31.01.2021 drawn up by the Chief Medical Officer to determine her age is 19 years.
The victim had eloped with the applicant and they got married.
Both were majors at the time of their marriage.
One child was born in the wedlock who is two years of age as on date.

Learned A.G.A. shall file an affidavit bringing all relevant documents including the statements of the victim/witnesses under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
Put up this matter on 15.05.2024, as fresh.
Both the parties shall appear before the Court on the next date of listing.

Till further orders, the charge-sheet dated 06.04.2022 in Case Crime No.27 of 2021 under Sections 363, 366,376 IPC and Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-11, Lakhimpur Khiri, shall remain stayed."
In compliance of the aforesaid order, the applicant Ashish Kumar and the alleged victim Laxmi are present before this Court.
They have been identified by their respective Advocates.

When this Court asked the alleged victim Laxmi that whether she has solemnized marriage with Ashish Kumar of her own sweetwill, she replied in affirmative and submits that she has solemnized marriage with Ashish Kumar of her own sweetwill and she was 19 years of age, when the marriage was solemnized.
She further submitted that due to their wedlock one male child, namely, Aryan Kumar was also born, who is now aged about two-and-a-half years, and she is living happily with the husband.
She also submits that the first information report was lodged by her father, who was not happy with this marriage, on the pressure created by the relatives and villagers.
She also submits that she was major at the time of marriage as per High School certificate, thus, she was free to solemnize marriage with whom she wanted of her own sweet will.
She further submitted that the allegation of rape in the first information report is false and whatever the relations have been made with the husband, are of her own will, without any force.

Learned counsel for the alleged victim submits that on the face of the statement made by the alleged victim under Section 161 and 164, Cr.P.C. as also before this court, the ingredients of Sections 363,
366, 376 as well as Section 3/4, POCSO Act are not attracted in the present case, as the victim is major.

sentences.text: The applicant Ashish Kumar also submits that she has solemnized marriage with the alleged victim Laxmi as per her consent and no pressure of any type was created on Laxmi.
He further submits that the allegation of rape is totally false.
At the time of marriage the victim was 19 years of age as per her educational qualification and her qualification is Class- 12.
He further submits that they both want to live together and the application be allowed.

Dr. V.K. Singh, learned Government Advocate, assisted by Sri Ashok Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A.
submits that as the couple, who is present before this Court, has solemnized their marriage with their own sweet will, without any pressure created by either of the party and both of them were major at the time of marriage, it appears that the present F.I.R. has been lodged by the father of the alleged victim on the pressure created by the villagers and the relatives and as per the statement made by the alleged victim as well as the applicant before this court, the ingredients ofSections 363,
366, 376 as well as Section 3/4, POCSO Act do not fulfill, and due to their wedlock one male child has also been born born, so, the present application may be allowed.

After considering the arguments as advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the records and the statements of the alleged victim Laxmi and the applicant Ashish Kumar given before this Court that they both have solemnized marriage of their sweetwill and the victim was 19 years of age at the time of marriage and was major, she was free to solemnize of her own sweetwill,
the applicant was also a major boy, and one male child had also been born, who is now aged about two-and-a-half years old, thus, it being a peculiar and special case, this court does not deem it appropriate and proper to continue the proceedings nor any useful purpose would be served by its continuance, hence, by exercising its extrajudicial power granted under Section 482, Cr.P.C., in the interest of justice, this court allows the instant application.

Proceedings oncharge-sheet dated 06.04.2022 in Case Crime No.27 of 2021 under Sections 363, 366,376 IPC and Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-11, Lakhimpur Khiri, are resultantly quashed.
